# Studio Veritas

> Studio Veritas is a creative strategy studio. Good strategy starts with
> hard questions — the studio finds the truth that makes brands matter.
> Slogan: "The truth will set you free."

## About

Studio Veritas gets under the brief to find the real problem and the
deeper need. It looks at the company, the category, and culture — what's
changing, what's working, what isn't — and finds the tension where big
ideas are born and growth happens. The studio works with companies and
agencies that need clear thinking, a sharp point of view, and creative
that's built on truth and made to work in the real world.

## Services

- **For companies**: Works directly with brand, marketing, innovation and
  design teams on strategic and creative projects.
- **For agencies**: Works as a freelance strategy, creative and design
  team for extra thinking, different perspectives, or specialist
  capability.

## Experience (selected work)

Page: /experience. Tiles of work, filterable by Brand, Comms, Retail and
Innovation (e.g. /experience?tag=brand); full case studies are linked, the
rest are marked "coming soon". Client logos: /clients (Client Experience).

- **Windhoek** (WINDHOEK) — Quality doesn't have to look German.
  Case study: /experience/windhoek. Problem: Windhoek's quality cues
  (Reinheitsgebot, Germanic naming, colonial-era visual language) coded
  quality as foreign rather than African. Truth: quality doesn't have to
  look German to be real; Africa has its own premium codes. Response:
  traded inherited European quality signifiers for local, premium African
  ones. Results: +2% market share in 2024; Windhoek Lager and Draught drove
  58.9% of total beer volume in Namibia in H2 2024; net revenue +19.8%;
  operating profit +10.6%.
- **Premiership Rugby** (PREM) — A platform built on the collision of
  tradition and raw spectacle.
- **Jordan Brand** (JORDAN WINGS) — Mentorship as the truth behind the
  mythology.
- **Seedlip** (SEEDLIP) — What to drink when you're not drinking.
  Case study "Hello Curious": /experience/seedlip. Problem: as the
  non-alcoholic category crowded, drinkers were unsure how Seedlip tasted,
  how to serve it and why it cost more; framed by absence, it risked
  reading as an expensive substitute. Truth: people choosing not to drink
  want sophisticated sensory pleasure, not an apology; curiosity, not
  restriction. Response: global platform "Hello Curious" — ingredients
  mapped to flavour, a signature highball serve ritual across on-trade and
  retail, and a modular visual system for seasonal moments. Results: global
  category leader in premium non-alcoholic spirits; double-digit trial and
  repeat; toolkit used in 20+ markets; price and shelf authority protected
  under Diageo.
- **Allbirds** (ALLBIRDS) — Nature knows better than we do.
- **Canyon** (CANYON) — Power ON: Game ON.
- **Uber Social Impact** (UBER SOCIAL IMPACT) — Thanking the everyday giants.
- **Icebreaker** (ICEBREAKER) — A natural alternative to synthetic.
- **Ketel One** (KETEL ONE) — Reframing the cocktail moment.
